question:
Match the columns.

 
 

 **States**
 **Cultural festivals**</t
solution:
The correct answer is** __A-I, B-II, C-IV, D-III.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jharkhand is known for Karma festival, which is celebrated in the month of August or September.**
 
• Himachal Pradesh celebrates Chaitraul festival, which is also known as the Spring Festival and is celebrated in the month of April.
 
• Telangana celebrates Bathukamma festival, which is celebrated during Navaratri and is dedicated to Goddess Gauri.
 
• **Punjab celebrates Lohri festival, which is a winter harvest festival and is celebrated on 13th January.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karma festival:****​**

 
 
• It is related to the harvest and a tribute to the Karam tree.
 
• Karam-Devta, the god of strength, vigor, and youthfulness, is worshipped there. 
 
 
 
• **Chaitraul festival:**
 
 
• it is considered as the festival of pictures and celebrated in the month of chaitra.
 
• A well-known celebration in the Sirmaur region is Chaitrual.
 
 
 
• **Telangana festival:**
 
 
• ​Nine days are dedicated to celebrating Bathukamma.
 
• It falls between the Durga Puja and Sharad Navratri festivals.
 
 
 
• **Lohri festival:**
 
 
• **​**People in the northern part of the Indian subcontinent celebrate Lohri.
 
• It signals the end of winter and signifies the arrival of longer days and the sun's journey to the Northern Hemisphere.
